m: निर्-√ 2. हा (only pr. p. Ā. निर्-जिहान), to rise out of (abl.), ascend, Rājat.

v: pu॰ nir + hada (hrada) vA GaY । SabdaBede KagAdInAM Sabde “sArasAnAYca nirhAdamatrodakamasaSayam” BA॰ ba॰ 3110 । “sArasEH kalanirhrAdEH kacidannamitA nanO” raGuH ।
m: निर्-हाद m. (√ हद्) evacuation, voiding excrement, MBh.; Var.

s: [n] tri, (niHSezeRa harati dUraM gacCatIti । nir + hf + Rini .) dUragAmiganDaH । ityamaraH । 1 । 5 । 11 ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 12 । 184 । 28 । “izwaScAnizwaganDaScaM maDuraH kawureva ca । nirhArI saMhataH snigDo rUkzo vizada eva vA ॥”)

puM, (nir + hf + GaY .) SalyAderutpAwanam । iti BarataH ॥ tatparyyAyaH । aByavakarzaRam 2 । ityamaraH । 3 । 2 । 17 ॥ malamUtrAdityAgaH । yaTA, Ahnikatattve । “AhAranirhAravihArayogAH susaMvftA DarmmavidA tu kAryyA ॥” dAhaH । iti smftiH ॥ (dAhArTaM nayanam । iti svAmI ॥ yaTA, BAgavate । 7 । 2 । 35 । “evaM vilapatInAM vE parigfhya gftaM patim । anicCatInAM nirhAramarko'sta saMnyavarttata ॥”) yaTezwaviniyogaH । yaTA, -- “na nirhAraM striyaH kuryyuH kuwumbA bahumaDyagAt । svakAdapi ca vfttAdDi svasya BartturanAjYayA ॥” iti manuH ॥
v: pu॰ nir + hf--GaY । 1 niKAtaSalyAdeH udDaraRe 2 malamUtrAdityAge “AhAranirhAravihArayogAH susaMvftA DarmavidA tu kAryyAH” A॰ ta॰ । 3 pretadehasya dAhArTaM bahirnayane, 4 yaTezwaviniyoge ca । “na nirhAraM striyaH kuryuH kuwumbAt bahumaDyagAt । svakAdapi ca vittAdDi svasya BarturanAjYayA” manuH ।
m: निर्-˚हार m. = ˚हरण, BhP.
setting aside or accumulation of a private store, a hoard, Mn. ix, 199
evacuation or voiding of excrement (opp. to आ-हार), MBh. xiii, 1796
deduction, Śulbas.
completion, L.
diffusive fragrance, W. (cf. ˚हारिन्).
a: निर्हारः — 1 Taking away, removing, removal. --2 Drawing out, extracting. --3 Rooting up, destruction. --4 Carrying out a dead body to be burnt. --5 Accumulation of a private store of wealth, private hoard; Ms. 9. 199. --6 Evacuation of the natural excrements of the body (opp. आहार). --7 Putting forth or out. --8 Setting aside, excluding, leaving.

m: निर्-˚हारण n. (fr. Caus.) causing (a dead body) to be carried out, Kull.

v: tri॰ nirharati bahirgamayati nir + hf--Rvul । SavAdergfhAt bahizkArake “pretanirhArakAScEva varjjanIyAH prayatnataH” manuH pretanirhArakasya apANkte yatvoktirDanagrahaRena tannirhArakavizayA । DarmmArTaM tannirhAre tu na dozaH “etadvE paramaM tapo yat pretamaraRyaM harantIvi” kullUkaBawwaDftaSrutyA tadviDAnAt ।
m: निर्-˚हारक mfn. carrying out (as a dead body; cf. प्रेत-निर्ह्˚)
purifying, L.

v: pu॰ nirharati dUraM gacCati nir + hf--Rini । 1 dUragAmiganDe amaraH । 2 nirharaRakarttari । 3 SavAderbahinizkArake tri॰ ca ।
m: निर्-˚हारिन् mfn. diffusively fragrant, MBh. xii, 6848
taking forth or out, W.
having wealth, ib.
a: निर्हारिन् — a. 1 Carrying out. --2 Diffusive, spreading wide (as fragrance). --3 Fragrant.

k.v: समाकर्षी तु निर्हारी सुरभिर्घ्राणतर्पणः। इष्टगन्धः सुगन्धिः स्यादामोदी मुखवासनः॥

m: निर्हक-कविवल्लभ m. N. of the author of a glossary, Cat.
निर्-√ हन् P. -हन्ति, to strike off, expel, remove, strike or knock out (eye, tooth &c.), hew down, kill, destroy, RV. &c. &c.: Caus. -घातयति, to take out, remove, Suśr.; to kill, destroy, MBh.
निर्-˚हरणीय (Kull.) mfn. to be taken away or removed.

s: klI, (niScayena haraRam । nir + hf + lyuw .) SavadAhaH । yaTA, SudDitattve । “tasya nirharaRAdIni samparetasya BArgava ! । yuDizWiraH kArayitvA muhUrttaM duHKito'Bavat ॥” (dahanam । yaTA, BAgavate । 7 । 7 । 28 । “bIjanirharaRaM yogaH pravAhoparamo DiyaH ॥”) niHSezeRa haraRaYca ॥
v: na॰ niHSezeRa haraRam । 1 dAhArTaM SavAderbahirharaRe, niHsAraRe ca । tasya nirharaRAdIni samparetasya BArgava! । yuDizWiraH kArayitvA muhUrttaM duHKito'Bavat” Su॰ ta॰ BAgavatavAkyam । 3 nASane ca “tasmAdBavadBiH karttavyaM karmmaRAM trimuRAtmanAm । vIjanirharaRam” BAga॰ 7728 ।
m: निर्-˚हरण n. taking out, extracting, expelling, removing, destroying, MBh.; Suśr.; Pur.
carrying out (esp. a dead body), MBh.; R. &c.
a: निर्हरणं — 1 Carrying out dead bodies to be burnt, carrying corpses to the funeral pile. --2 Taking forth, carrying or drawing out, extracting, removal. --3 Rooting up, extirpation, destruction.

m: निर्-˚हर्तव्य (Suśr.) mfn. to be taken away or removed.
निर्—हस्त (निर्-), mfn. handless, AV. (cf. नैर्-ह्˚),
निर्हत mfn. struck down (cf. उल्का-निर्ह्˚).
निर्—हेति mfn. weaponless, unarmed, Yājñ.
निर्—हेतु mfn. causeless, reasonless, MBh.
निर्—हेतु—ता f. want of a cause or reason, Sāh.
निर्—हेतु—त्व n. want of a cause or reason, Sāh.

निर्-√ हृ P. Ā. -हरति, ˚ते, to take out or off, draw or pull out, extract from (abl.), expel, remove, destroy, RV. &c. &c.; to export (goods), Mn.; to carry out (a dead body), ib.; Yājñ.; to let (blood), Suśr.; to purge, ib.; (Ā.) to exclude or deliver from (abl.), TS.; ŚBr.; to shake off, get rid of (acc.), Āpast.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to change or interchange (clothes), Mn. viii, 396; to fix, Śulbas.; to get, receive, SaddhP. : Caus. -हारयति, to cause (a dead body) to be carried out, Kull. on Mn. v, 104 : Desid. -जिहीर्षति, to wish to take off or subtract, Śulbas. (cf. निर्-जिहीर्षु).
a: निर्हृ — {c1c} P. 1 To take or draw out from, extract; R. 14. 42. --2 To carry out the dead body; Ms. 5. 91; Y. 3. 15. --3 To remove (as a fault &c.) --4 To carry or take away. --5 To export (goods). --6 To change or mix together (clothes &c.).

m: निर्-˚हृत mfn. taken or carried forth or out, extracted, removed &c., MBh.; Suśr.; Rājat.; BhP.
निर्-˚हृति f. taking away, removal, Kām.
a: निर्हृतिः — f. Taking out of one's way, removal.

m: 1. निर्-˚हृत्य mfn. to be taken or left out, TBr.
2. निर्-˚हृत्य ind. having taken out or extracted, W.

m: निर्—हिम n. (or अम् ind.) cessation of winter, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 6, Kāś.
निर्—हिमम् ind.
निर्—ह्लाद mfn. joyless, uncomfortable, uneasy, Mālav. i, 17/18.
निर्-√ ह्राद् Caus. -ह्रादयति, to cause to sound, beat (a drum), Kāṭh.

m: निर्-˚ह्रादन n. sound, cry, Kpr.
निर्-˚ह्रादिन् mfn. sounding, humming, roaring, Kāv.; Kathās.

निर्-˚ह्रसित mfn. shortened, Nir.
निर्-˚ह्रस्त mfn. abridged, diminished, ĀśvŚr.
